record.question: Which film won the Oscar for Best Picture Award in 2019?
record.explanation: Answer C: Green Book. The Academy’s original 2019 ceremony record names Green Book as Best Picture winner. Bohemian Rhapsody won more individual awards overall, but the category asked here is specifically Best Picture. Historical/source note: Best Picture at the 91 st ceremony in 2019, not the film with the most total wins. Reference: https://www.oscars.org/oscars/ceremonies/2019/G. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
